checkpoints.title: Add book ratings feature
steps: Implemented rateBook and getRatingsStats functions in a new ratings service
Extended GET /books/:id to include average rating and ratings count
Added POST /books/:id/ratings to create or update member rating for a book
checkpoints.impact: The library service now supports rating books by members and returns average ratings in book details.
checkpoints.overview: This change introduces the ability for members to rate books with stars from 1 to 5. Ratings are stored in a new collection keyed by book and member, allowing updates to replace existing ratings. The average rating and count of ratings are calculated and returned via the existing book details endpoint. A new endpoint is added to submit ratings for a book by a member.
